formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --background: 220 16% 22%;
  --foreground: 218 27% 94%;
  --card: 222 16% 28%;
  --card-foreground: 218 27% 94%;
  --popover: 222 16% 28%;
  --popover-foreground: 218 27% 94%;
  --muted: 220 16% 32%;
  --muted-foreground: 219 28% 70%;
  --accent: 220 16% 32%;
  --accent-foreground: 218 27% 94%;
  --border: 220 17% 36%;
  --input: 220 17% 36%;
  --ring: 218 27% 94%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 20% 0%, rgba(143, 188, 187, 0.16) 0%, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 90% 100%, rgba(180, 142, 173, 0.14) 0%, transparent 70%), #2e3440;
}


.login-content > div {
  max-width: 420px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 1px solid #4c566a;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #3b4252;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type button {
  color: #a3adbf;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  border: 1px solid #4c566a;
  background: #2e3440;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  color: #a3adbf;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: #434c5e !important;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #d8dee9;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid #4c566a;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #2e3440;
  color: #eceff4;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio'])::placeholder {
  color: #a3adbf;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 25%, transparent);
}
.login-password button {
  color: #a3adbf;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #a3adbf;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #2e3440;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #2e3440;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  filter: brightness(1.08);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-forget-password label {
  color: #d8dee9;
}
#footer {
  color: #a3adbf;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
